title: Fourier factor for matching edge labels
statement: Let $q$, $k$, and $n$ be natural numbers. Given a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, a perfect matching in the complete multipartite graph with $q$ parts of size $k$, a part $i$, and an assignment of an $n$-valued label to each matching edge, the corresponding Fourier factor is the absolute value of the Fourier coefficient indexed by the set of labels on the matching edges selected at the vertices in part $i$.
